detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #14 Session-aligned DHCP DHCP starts talking before the browser opens. PH4NTXM prepares its DHCP settings before the first lease request, aligning them with the session hostname and protected MAC. Linux uses a dhclient vendor class; Windows uses MSFT 5.0 with its own timeout and session DUID settings. The generated record feeds NetworkManager defaults and active-device updates. In normal modes, the physical-output guard additionally validates and normalizes supported DHCPv4 requests, including their option layout. Identity consistency has to reach the lease negotiation itself. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
